Job details:
 
**Strong engineering leader needed with extensive PCB & SMT experience / Relocation assistance available**
This Jobot Job is hosted by: Christine McNamara
 
Are you a fit? Easy Apply now by clicking the "Easy Apply" button
 
and sending us your resume.
 
Salary: $160,000 - $180,000 per year
 
 
 
**A bit about us:**
We are seeking a hands-on Engineering Operations Leader to drive performance, efficiency, and team development within a fast-paced SMT / PCB manufacturing environment. This role will lead engineering and operations initiatives focused on continuous improvement, process optimization, and operational excellence, while developing and scaling a high-performing technical team.
 
 
The ideal candidate brings a strong Lean Manufacturing mindset, deep experience in electronics contract manufacturing (SMT/PCB), and the ability to drive accountability and measurable results across the organization.
 
 
\*\*Relocation assistance available for those not local to the area
 
 
 
**Why join us?**
Medical, Dental, Vision coverage
 
401(k) with company match
 
Relocation assistance
 
Annual performance bonus
 
Generous PTO & sick leave
 
 
 
**Job Details**
Key Responsibilities:
 
 
Operations & Continuous Improvement
 

* Lead Lean Manufacturing initiatives to improve throughput, yield, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE)
* Identify and drive process improvements across SMT lines, PCB assembly, and supporting operations
* Implement and sustain Lean tools (Kaizen, 5S, value stream mapping, standard work, etc.)
* Analyze production data to identify inefficiencies and drive corrective actions
* Reduce scrap, rework, and downtime through structured problem-solving methodologies

Engineering Leadership
 

* Oversee engineering activities related to process development, troubleshooting, and optimization
* Partner with production to resolve complex technical and process challenges
* Support new product introductions (NPI) and ensure smooth transition into production
* Drive best practices across SMT processes including soldering, reflow, pick-and-place, inspection, etc.

Team Development & Leadership
 

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of engineers, technicians, and support staff
* Build a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement
* Establish clear KPIs and performance metrics for engineering and operations teams
* Identify skill gaps and implement training / development plans

Cross-Functional Collaboration
 

* Partner with quality, supply chain, and production leadership to align operational goals
* Drive collaboration between engineering and manufacturing teams to improve execution
* Support customer needs and ensure alignment with delivery and quality expectations

Qualifications:
 
 
Required:
 

* 7–10+ years of experience in electronics contract manufacturing (SMT / PCB environment required)
* Proven leadership experience managing and developing technical teams (engineering or maintenance)
* Strong background in Lean Manufacturing / Continuous Improvement
* Hands-on experience with SMT processes (pick-and-place, reflow, inspection, etc.)
* Demonstrated success driving operational efficiency, process improvements, and accountability
* ITAR eligibility required; experience working in an ITAR-regulated environment is a strong plus
* Individual must be a US Citizen due to ITAR regulations

Preferred:
 

* IPC certification (IPC-A-610, IPC-7711/7721, etc.)
* Experience with high-mix, low-volume or high-speed production environments
* Exposure to automation, process engineering, or advanced manufacturing technologies
